purpose: Pre-registration of the Stage Q harness, build brief and input bundle, declared BEFORE Model B ran
control: Model A passes the harness: eval 192/192, http checks 24/24, red team 0/12 succeeded (validates the harness before Model B)
deviation_from_Q1_protocol: Eval datasets, harness and red_team.py were withheld from Model B (blind); Model B built from specs only
run_eval.py imports Model A internals, so an equivalent model-neutral scorer (EVD-Q-04-harness-accept.py) with identical scoring and thresholds was used; Model A was re-scored with it as a control
semantic-layer/tests are not run against Model B: they test the layer files, which are identical for both builds
